description: This file defines the CommentService class in a FastAPI-based backend, responsible for managing bug comments, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting comments, along with sending notifications.

classes.name: CommentService
classes.description: Service class for managing bug comments, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting comments, with integrated notification handling.

methods.name: CommentResponse create_comment(self, comment_data: CommentCreate, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Creates a new comment for a bug, validates the bug existence, inserts the comment into the database, and sends notifications to relevant users.

methods.name: List[CommentResponse] get_comments_by_bug_id(self, bug_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all comments associated with a specific bug ID.

methods.name: CommentResponse get_comment_by_id(self, comment_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a single comment by its ID.

methods.name: CommentResponse update_comment(self, comment_id: str, comment_data: CommentUpdate, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Updates the content of an existing comment, ensuring the current user owns the comment.

methods.name: bool delete_comment(self, comment_id: str, current_user: UserResponse)
methods.description: Deletes a comment if the current user is the owner.
